messages:
incident-bot: [AUTOPAGER] HIGH 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (prod, us-west1). 5m error rate 18.2% (threshold 7%). Customers: high-traffic routes. Pager: ben. Severity: P1. Runbook: <https://runbooks.internal/redwood/5xx-triage>
ben: Acked. I'm taking primary. Will confirm scope and start triage. :eyes:
alice: Oncall logs show a spike starting ~1975311800, correlates with increased request size distribution. K/V cache miss rate up ~4x. Posting quick graphs.
charu: Can you check kvcache eviction logs and model worker OOMs? Also verify rolling canary traffic isn't hitting an old backend.
ben: Checking workers and infra now. `kubectl -n inference get pods | grep west1` — pod counts look healthy. `tail -n 200 /var/log/kvcache/evict.log` shows mass evictions around 1975311700.
alice: Also seeing elevated tail latency on the embedding service used by reranker. Could be cascading timeouts. 503s from embedder to generator around same window.
charu: If embedder latency spikes -> generator queues up -> upstream 5xx. Try routing to embedder fallback pool and reduce batch sizes for /v1/generate temporarily.
dmitri: I'm on standby to scale pools if needed. Ben, want me to open a scaling action now?
ben: Yes, please scale dedicated-inference-pool-west1 +1 replica and enable fallback-routing to embedder-fallback. I will apply a quick cache warmup policy.
ben: Running commands:
```
# scale pool
infractl pools scale --region=us-west1 --pool=dedicated-inference --replicas=18
# enable fallback
routes update --route=/v1/generate --fallback=embedder-fallback --enable
```
incident-bot: Action logged: infractl job 77321 started by ben. Expected stabilization ~2m.
elena (pm): Heads up — some active customers on realtime plan may see retries. I flagged support to prep a status blurb.
charu: Good. Also suggest toggling `batch.max_tokens` down to 512 for the hot route to avoid long-running requests.
ben: Applied batch cap. Also prewarmed KV cache for top prefixes. `kvcache warm --prefixes=/v1/generate/top-10`.
alice: Metrics update: 5xx rate dropped from 18.2% -> 6.8% after scale + fallback (1975312500). Latency p95 improved ~30%.
dmitri: Taking over as primary for the next 30m while ben documents steps and syncs with support. ben, handoff successful?
ben: Handoff ✅. I'll post a short summary and follow up with logs. Next steps: monitor error rate, confirm embedder queue drains, run a canary for normal traffic.
elena (pm): I'll update the incident page and notify customers if we see regression. No wide customer outage confirmed yet but risk existed — good catch.
charu: Leaving a short remediation note in the runbook: add kvcache eviction alert and automated fallback to embedder-fallback if embedder latency > 200ms for 3m.
ben: Attaching quick debug snippets to the incident doc. If error rate creeps >8% again, re-pager and escalate to platform leads.
dmitri: Monitoring. Will escalate if >8% sustained. Closing my on-call note, continuing watch.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial. 5xx rate at 4.1% and trending down. Auto-check scheduled in 5m. Logs archived to /incidents/1975312468/logs
